enums.name: NetworkInterfaceKind
enums.description: Standardized platform network interface kind for active reconnect hints.

models.name: NetworkChangeRequest
models.description: Platform network-change notification used to trigger active reconnect.

fields.name: available
fields.description: Whether a network route is currently available. Omitted means available.

fields.name: expensive
fields.description: Whether the active route is considered expensive by the platform.

fields.name: metered
fields.description: Whether the active route is metered.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Optional platform reason string for diagnostics.

models.name: NetworkChangeResponse
models.description: Result of handling a platform network-change notification.

fields.name: reconnected
fields.description: Whether the SDK had an active session and attempted reconnect.
